android.desc:
ClothesCast tells you what to wear based on the weather.

Every morning, you get a clear recommendation like: "Today will be 4°C warmer than yesterday. Wear t-short and shorts." or "Rain likely at 3pm — bring an umbrella." 

You decide what "cold enough for a sweater" or "hot enough for shorts" means.

OPTIONAL WIDGET
See today's top + bottom outfit pair on the home screen alongside tonight's and tomorrow's — no extra taps needed.

OPTIONAL CALENDAR INTEGRATION
If you allow calendar access, and you have any evening events, ClothesCast will include evening clothing recommendations, like "Bring a jacket this evening". No event titles leave your device.

VOICE OPTIONS
• Natural online voices using Gemini or use your device's built-in voices.
• 40+ language and accent pairs.

COMPLETELY PRIVATE
All permissions are opt-in. Never sends your personal information to anyone. Your location is only sent to the weather provider, and is rounded to the nearest 1 kilometer for your privacy.

RELIABLE BACKGROUND DELIVERY
Scheduled using Android's most reliable alarm API so notifications arrive on time even when the phone is in Doze mode, after a reboot, or after a timezone change.

ALSO INCLUDED
• Hourly and 7-day forecast views with feels-like vs. air temperature toggle and cross-model confidence bands.
• Home screen widget showing today's outfit at a glance.
• °C / °F, km / miles, 40+ languages.
